svg.title: Process engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as process engineer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: An opposing-triangle process valve lies in a horizontal pipe beneath a separate gauge branch. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
